title: The Resurrection
speaker: Antwan Cronje
summary:
Take the resurrection out of Christianity and nothing is left worth keeping. Paul says so himself. In the Apostles' Creed series, Pastor Antwan lays out the minimal-facts case even non-Christian historians grant, answers the two biggest objections, then opens 1 Corinthians 15 and Revelation 5 to show what the empty tomb really settles. If the disciples were lying, why did every one of them die for it?

Notes: Read the sermon notes
quotes: No one dies for a lie that they know is a lie.
The empty tomb is God settling your account.
The issue is not the size of your faith but who it rests on.
